findings.text: Tier-1 is 293 authored sentence frames rendered 3,750 times by proper-noun substitution. The floor is 3,750 frames. At the normal distance -- one conversation -- it reads as the intended object; two cast members in one session say the same sentence with different names in it, which is the half-distance failure C3 names.

DLG-03's arithmetic is stale against the register it derives from: the spec says 29 counters across 27 places, dialogue.serve_places()/serve_tokens() read 28 and 30 from directory.PLACES, so the per-counter floor is 180 rather than 174. R1 forbids editing either side; this is a SPEC-CHANGE the owner owns.
